Touch controls

Move Wander with the left stick. Drag an empty area on the right to look around.

Hold Grab to climb and combine it with Jump. Use Attack for the sword or bow. Agro calls or urges the horse on.

Tap Map to open the game map. Tap Menu to open the options and adjust the controls.
